items.title: MECH-464: ARC-109 D1/D2 opponent-gain reorder-vs-straddle probe
items.note: GOV-REUSE-1: decisive readout (per-tick D1/D2 reorder-vs-da0 conditioned on pre-split straddle fraction) never recorded by any prior manifest -- GateDVRecorder (which reads loop_assoc_straddle_frac/loop_limbic_straddle_frac/loop_d1_d2_reorder_vs_da0) had zero prior consumers; not recoverable by reanalysis, must run. Substrate readiness: straddle-fraction non-vacuity gate + da=0 shadow argmin instrumentation confirmed present in e3_selector.py (built for MECH-464 but never previously consumed by a queued script) and empirically reachable via a live one-tick probe (2026-09-10) that also found and worked around an undocumented substrate gap: use_loop_segregation=True alone never reaches _segregated_loop_arbitrate without also setting use_f_eligibility_demotion (or use_modulatory_shortlist_then_modulate). red-team (same-model fallback, sonnet-5; fable spawn hit an account spend limit mid-review): CONTESTED -> FIXED -- C2 confinement criterion lacked a minimum-N floor on its straddle==0 comparison bucket; added straddle_zero_bucket_scorable precondition mirroring the existing straddle>0 tercile floor. Dispatching chip prompt named a nonexistent proposal_id (EXP-1069); the real, matching, unqueued proposal for MECH-464 was EXP-1067 (backlog_id EVB-1579) -- used that instead.
